每个 body 的输入由 25 个传出桶和 25 个传入桶组成。相关突触累计后，: Each body has 25 outgoing and 25 incoming buckets. Integer-quantized counts form a 50-dimensional vector, expanded to 2,000 outputs. Each output reads six inputs; the strongest 100 survive.
激活值相同时，以输出索引打破并列；winner 列表按升序编码。所有计算使用整数: Output index breaks activation ties. Winners are encoded in ascending order. Integer arithmetic avoids floating-point and platform-RNG differences.

可研究分块的 STARK 或 zkVM 计算证明，再递归聚合。是否适用，取决于真: Chunked STARK or zkVM proofs with recursive aggregation require evaluation at the actual data scale.
扫描文件和随机访问不能远程证明全部数据始终驻留物理 RAM。当前使用 mmap，: Scanning and random access do not remotely prove continuous RAM residency. The implementation uses mmap, with residency managed by the operating system.
FlyHash 指纹是连接模式近似检索的候选表示。若要宣称科学价值，必须公开查询: FlyHash fingerprints are a candidate representation for connectivity retrieval. Scientific utility needs public queries, baselines, Recall@K, mAP, latency and construction-cost measurements.
目前已验证计算可以执行、结果可以复算。检索质量和重复计算的边际价值，仍需独立实验: Execution and reproducibility have been tested. Retrieval quality and the marginal value of repeated computation still need independent experiments.
当前为本地共识实验。候选区块没有 P2P 确认、交易或余额；记录编号不是链高度。: The local coordinator now supports signed wallets, staking, attestations and a persistent test ledger. It does not provide independent P2P consensus.

FlyHash 用稀疏二值投影将输入扩张到更高维度，再通过 winner-tak: FlyHash expands inputs with sparse binary projections, then retains a small set of winners. Similar inputs tend to overlap, which supports approximate similarity search.

PoW 要让节点确认：提交结果对应确定的挑战，并满足规定目标。仅靠相似性编码，不: PoW lets a node check that a result belongs to a fixed challenge and meets a target. Similarity codes alone neither provide cryptographic security nor prevent precomputation and task-selection bias.
FlyHash 为连接草图生成指纹。区块挑战绑定全量数据根、索引根与模板；每个: FlyHash fingerprints connectivity sketches. A challenge binds the full data root, index root and template. Each nonce performs 256 dependent accesses, followed by a domain-separated, length-prefixed SHA-256 transcript.
FlyHash 负责稀疏表示，数据访问构成工作的一部分，SHA-256 提供最终: FlyHash supplies the sparse representation, data accesses contribute work, and SHA-256 supplies the final hash. This combination still requires independent analysis; memory-hardness and ASIC resistance are not automatic.
能否有效检索相关神经元，需要与基线比较 Recall@K 和 mAP。网页验证计: Retrieval needs Recall@K and mAP comparisons against baselines. Verifying computation does not establish scientific retrieval quality.

这保留了所有输入。变化的是存储和构建顺序，而不是计算规则。: All inputs are preserved. Only storage and construction order change.

每个叶哈希仍绑定数据根、seed、body ID 与全部 100 个 winne: Every leaf still binds the data root, seed, body ID and all 100 winners. Tests compare compressed and in-memory implementations and obtain identical fingerprints and artifact roots.
